# Menuz: Comprehensive Technical & Architectural System Overview

## 1. System Identity & Mission
Menuz is an autonomous restaurant operating system and digital dining platform created for fine dining and casual eateries in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
The system is designed with zero-app-download architecture: guests scan table QR codes on native iOS/Android camera apps, opening a lightweight PWA that enables real-time collaborative ordering, dietary customization, kitchen ticket printing, and Google review generation.

## 2. Architectural Architecture & Subsystems
1. Customer Dining Application (Root: `/` and `/#/r/:restaurantSlug/menu`)
   - Interactive high-definition food presentation
   - Dietary filtering (Veg, Non-Veg, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Jain, Chef Specials)
   - Real-time multiplayer synchronized table cart
   - Interactive Table Arcade (Solitaire, Crossword, Table Trivia, Who Pays The Bill)
   - Direct kitchen ordering with order status tracking
   - 1-click Google review recommendation builder

2. Restaurant Partner Operations Hub (`/owner/` and `/#/manage`)
   - Food Operations Hub with live table grid
   - Kitchen Display System (KDS) for course pacing and ticket completion
   - 1-click ESC/POS 80mm thermal receipt and KOT printing
   - Menu engineering studio and pricing controls
   - Google Review floor grievance alert shield

3. Master Admin HQ Command Center (`/hq/` and `/#/hq`)
   - Multi-tenant restaurant ecosystem directory (3,000+ Pune venues)
   - Live table QR token generator and floor layout configurator
   - Real-time bidirectional POS synchronizers (Petpooja, RoyalPOS, Recaho, RanceLab)
   - Realtime multi-client SSE state broadcaster

## 4. Hardware & Integration Specifications
- Printer Protocol: Standard ESC/POS raster and text mode commands (80mm width, 576 dots/line)
- Port: TCP Port 9100 for network thermal printers; WebUSB for direct USB connection
- POS Sync: RESTful JSON polling and webhook ingestion for order status mapping
